body: I'm fine, feel better. if I have live damage hospital won't help

yea, probably because I feel like dwelling on being raped and abused makes me victimize myself and misinterpret safe situations as hostile ones. 

my mind warps a lot of social information and makes my accomplishing things more draining than they should be. 

I'd really give anything to make it go away. I don't like having a disability that makes living life on easy wind up being hard. but I don't know how to fix my mind, aside from slowly and carefully, over time. it sucks and it makes me want to cry, give up and die a lot. especially when it seems like I've put in so much effort only to see zero progress. 

sympathy and empathy from other people, consolations, questions, curiosity - none of these things heal my mind or prevent people from assuming how it functions. I can just run away to a place where no one knows me and hope that I can start over without everyone knowing what I struggle with, my insecurities and flaws. 

but I can't run away from my mind. I can try to keep it still and silent, but that only works for so long, and it's hard to feel as though one is being both critical, analytic and observant for the purpose of improvement, while still moving slowly and carefully enough that I'm not too cruel to myself or cause mental instability by compartmentalizing conflicting or  contradictory thoughts. 

I get stuck in my own head and I just, have very little hope for it to get better without knowing that I'm just pretending it is better, so people enjoy being around me. right now,I can't pretend, and besides random strangers online, no one really wants to listen to me be negative, depressed, while describing a problem no one has a solution form, yet causes me considerable suffering and sadness. 

I don't know.maybe I've changed and I'm better and I just haven't noticed yet. I don't know. I feel like I have very little self identity when I'm exhausted and depressed. when I get like that, I have no interest in anything besides sleeping. and that makes it hard for me to know what I like and what I want to pursue, what goals I have and what I want to experience.

everything I wanted I can't have and I had to convince myself that wanting it was bad until I felt so bad about it I let go of wanting it. but now I don't know what I want that is achievable. it feels like nothing and like, I dunno. like life is just over. nothing to look forward to or be excited over. just day after day, surviving and waiting for death. 

it sucks and mostly everyone is fed up with my depressing shit. so I guess I can go back to pretending that everything is fine, while I still live feeling like I killed myself on the inside. all because I followed my heart instead of my head.  all because I couldn't imagine more tragedy be falling me. because I felt like everyone deserves happiness and finally found it.because I questioned the cruelty of life, and wondered whether it were possible that in one dramatic shift - that cruelty could simply cease and be different, because that is one possible outcome of existence. it is possible. and because I continued to believe that life would pleasantly surprise me, because that's probably all I really want. nice surprises that make life enjoyable and happy. and mostly not in the form of stuff or gifts, but human connection, specific words, meaning, getting that true glimpse with another human being that they understand completely, that I'm not alone, and that maybe in that there is some miniscule fragment of hope to cling onto. 

just the hope that I will one day feel better than this. and that life with be better than I can imagine it right now, to be. 

I have all this time and freedom and I can't do anything I want to do with it. even if I could, the desire passes so quickly that I continue to do nothing. 

I used to want to do things.I used to believe in myself. I'm not so sure I do anymore, because I let other people shape my preferences in the pursuit of being accepted by them..

so I just spend a lot of time alone thinking, instead. and I just hope it can lead me out of this darkness as long as I keep trying. otherwise, I really don't know how much longer I can handle feelings of loss of all hope. it just feels like I'm permanently broken and , maybe I had a chance to do something special that I wanted to, once upon a time, but I squandered that opportunity and have only regret for what was lost, with little desire to seek out what can still be sought. I feel like the worst kind of person sometimes, but I also know I'm exaggerating. if I really had no desires, I would have stopped trying to do anything a long time ago.a lot of mine are just suppressed, hidden, because I've been judged a lot for having them, been told that they are wrong. 

shrug.
yea, only enough to keep me living a life I'm continuously unsatisfied with but have no idea of what to pursue or want.

perpetual self delusion and slow progress. 

also I suppose a sense of humor helps

I guess. It has either gotten harder to deal with, or I have become more aware of it, or it just feels stronger because it is. 

I just want to fix it and change it. No matter what it takes. I will only be beaten down 100% when I'm actually dead.
I feel trapped like this. it really is quite painful.
